issuer_condition: Identity and minimum commercial data; buyer is not the platform
precondition: Product description; quantity and unit; destination; required certificates if known
error_risks: Ambiguous specification; missing destination; duplicate; impersonation; prohibited concealment request

issuer_condition: Seller identity; date; validity; goods; price; currency; delivery and payment terms
recipient: Buyer; platform and forwarder when needed
precondition: Sufficient product and logistics data; valid_until; named place and Incoterms
error_risks: Currency or quantity mismatch; expired validity; missing Incoterms; unauthorized quote
evidence_label: customary practice with conditional legal effect

issuer_condition: Quote-linked version marked PRO FORMA with goods; quantity; price; currency; origin; delivery/payment terms
recipient: Buyer; bank or destination authority for preliminary process
precondition: Commercial acceptance or stated preliminary use; not final payment invoice
error_risks: Used as commercial invoice; missing mark; stale price; mismatch with PO or contract; forgery

issuer_condition: Internal approval; PO number; seller; goods; quantity; price; delivery and payment terms
stage: After quote/PI or before them depending transaction
precondition: Buyer authority and resolved term differences; seller acceptance for fulfillment
error_risks: No seller acceptance; conflicting terms; duplicate PO; wrong ship-to; mismatch with invoice

issuer: Buyer and seller or authorized signatories
issuer_condition: Authority to sign; agreement on goods; quantity; price or method; delivery; law; dispute terms
recipient: Both parties; bank/carrier/insurer/authority only when needed
precondition: KYB/KYC; specification; Incoterms version and named place; schedule and annexes
error_risks: Unauthorized signature; missing governing law; ambiguous specification; inconsistent PO/PI
evidence_label: legal fact conditional on applicable law

issuer_condition: Final real transaction data; authorized signature; destination-specific content
recipient: Buyer; customs; broker; carrier; bank when LC applies
stage: When goods and transaction data are final, before/at shipment
precondition: Contract; actual quantity/value; reconciliation with packing and PO/contract
error_risks: Wrong value/HS/origin/party; PI used as CI; mismatch across documents; unauthorized signature

issuer_condition: Packing complete; physical tally; marks; packages; dimensions; net and gross weight
precondition: Physical tally and invoice reference
error_risks: Package/weight/marks mismatch; poor packing; post-inspection alteration; used instead of invoice

issuer: Chamber or reliable authorized authority; exporter supplies origin evidence
issuer_condition: Origin evidence; shipment linkage; authorized form/signature; preference rule if applicable
stage: After origin and consignment data are stable, before/with shipment
precondition: Production/purchase evidence; invoice; packing; applicable rule of origin
error_risks: Wrong origin type; issuer not authorized; mismatch; expired/fake certificate; split shipment issue

issuer_condition: Carrier received cargo; shipping instructions; shipper data; VGM for packed container; on-board notation when applicable
recipient: Shipper; consignee; notify party; carrier; customs; bank
precondition: Contract of carriage; accurate marks/quantity/weight; VGM where applicable
error_risks: Wrong party/port/description; received confused with on board; container/seal mismatch; unauthorized document

issuer: Exporter/owner or authorized customs agent submits; customs accepts or rejects
issuer_condition: Authorization; classification; origin; value; quantity; weight; packages; permits; supporting documents
recipient: Customs and border regulators; destination importer/agent for import filing
stage: After invoice/packing/permits and before exit or entry
precondition: Authorized declarant; complete data; applicable national system
error_risks: Wrong HS/origin/value; incomplete attachments; expired permit; no authority; inspection or rejection
evidence_label: official customs data standard; national law dependent

issuer_condition: Application satisfies item/destination/end-use and quantity scope
recipient: Exporter/importer; customs; carrier; bank when required
precondition: Classification; end-use; application and destination rule
error_risks: Wrong scope; expired permit; unlicensed export; incomplete end-use

issuer: Export country NPPO authorized public officer
issuer_condition: Inspection/sampling/treatment and import requirements met
stage: Before dispatch or as destination requires
precondition: Regulated plant material; consignment identifiable; accepted paper/ePhyto route
error_risks: Wrong scientific name/lot/origin; treatment missing; additional declaration wrong; unaccepted ePhyto

issuer: Export country veterinary or competent authority/official veterinarian
issuer_condition: Model certificate and health requirements met
recipient: Destination veterinary authority; customs; importer; carrier
precondition: Health inspection; establishment/lot; negotiated destination requirements
error_risks: Wrong species/lot; missing official signature/stamp; wrong consignee; unreadable electronic record

issuer: Export health/food authority or recognized body
issuer_condition: Inspection/test and destination format accepted
stage: Before export for regulated food/health goods
precondition: Product rule; lot; test/inspection; accepted authority
error_risks: Wrong lot/language; expired test; unrecognized authority; overbroad health claim

issuer_condition: Applicable standard/directive and evidence of testing
precondition: Product model; technical file; applicable standard; accredited body when required
error_risks: Wrong standard/version; body not accepted; model/serial mismatch; expired report

issuer_condition: Scope, sampling, inspection and quantity/quality/value report completed
precondition: Goods ready; inspector and scope accepted; contract/LC condition if any
error_risks: Nonrepresentative sample; unsigned report; wrong date/place; mismatch; nonaccepted agency

issuer_condition: Treatment performed and linked to package/wood marks
stage: After packing before dispatch when required
precondition: Identified packages; treatment date and mark; destination rule
error_risks: Wrong package; invalid mark; date/permit error; repacking after treatment

issuer_condition: Audit/slaughter/process and accepted scope completed
precondition: Product/ingredients/process; accepted certifier; lot
error_risks: Body not accepted; ingredients/lot mismatch; expired or unlegalized certificate

issuer_condition: Coverage, insured party/value/route and exclusions agreed; seller obligation only under applicable term/contract
precondition: Contract/Incoterms; insured goods/value/route; beneficiary
error_risks: Wrong beneficiary/value/route; exclusion; late placement; failure to notify loss

issuer_condition: Handover record with order/shipment; packages; date/place; receiver
precondition: Authorized receiver; tally and location evidence
error_risks: Wrong receiver; unsigned note; quantity mismatch; no damage notation

issuer_condition: Delivery timestamp/location and authorized consignee acknowledgement
precondition: Identity/authority of receiver; shipment reference
error_risks: Forged signature; partial delivery; hidden damage; missing time/location

issuer: Importer/warehouse for GRN; carrier/terminal for release order
issuer_condition: Tally/inspection or right-to-deliver condition met
stage: Arrival after customs release and document/charge check
precondition: PO/CI/B/L/lot link; customs release; original or e-release when required
error_risks: Wrong party; missing original/e-release; unpaid charges; customs hold; mixed lot

issuer_condition: Written notice with order/shipment, event, amount or determinable remedy, evidence and deadline
recipient: Counterparty; carrier; insurer; bank/authority as applicable
stage: After overdue, loss, damage, delay or nonconformity
precondition: Contract/policy/B/L; inspection and evidence; timely notice
error_risks: Late notice; vague nature; wrong respondent; missing evidence; inconsistent names/amount

issuer: Party whose claim was rejected or unresolved
issuer_condition: Notice referencing clause, chronology, evidence, relief and forum
stage: After failed claim negotiation or no response
precondition: Governing law; dispute clause; notice address; legal hold
error_risks: Wrong forum; missed deadline; incomplete evidence; public disclosure of confidential data
